lanekeeper.note: The format of Lighthouse CI's lighthouserc, read by scripts/perf/lighthouse.mjs (the plan's W31 fallback: lighthouse 13.5.0 and a small runner, because @lhci/cli's tree has nine audit findings). The paths are on the perf build behind the harness (scenario `perf`), which serves them as the hub does, with no Content-Encoding. A page's score is the median of its runs; the budget is the lowest of the pages, so a page cannot hide behind another.
